# Ironvale vendored content foundation

Pinned CC0 runtime-format source assets for Ironvale world building. They live outside `public/` so ordinary Cloudflare deploys do not upload the full source library.

`asset-lock.json` records immutable provenance and SHA-256 hashes. `registry.json` provides stable asset IDs. Selected assets are optimized/promoted into `public/assets/` only when used.
